content.short: Borg Security is a Web3 zeroday research firm specializing in cross Web3/Web2 infrastructures.
content.description: Borg Security strengthens project security through thorough penetration testing. Beyond standard assessments, it concentrates on zero-day research to uncover high-impact, hard-to-find exploits that others may miss. Clients receive detailed reports describing identified vulnerabilities and actionable, expert recommendations to mitigate risk effectively, helping teams address weaknesses before they can be exploited. This approach emphasizes practical mitigation guidance to help teams reduce risk and strengthen overall security posture.
